item.title: WBCQ's 500 kW Superstation: Owner Seeks a Lease, or a Buyer, After 9330 kHz Went Silent
item.description: WLC Radio Ministry, which says it owns WBCQ's 500 kW Superstation in Maine, told ShortwaveHQ it wants to lease the idle 9330 kHz transmitter, or sell it. No price is set and the FCC license is not included. Here's what is known.

item.title: RTI's French Service Returns to Shortwave for August 2026
item.description: Radio Taiwan International's French Service is running special direct shortwave broadcasts from Taiwan every Friday, Saturday, and Sunday through August 30, 2026, aimed at listeners in Europe and North Africa.
